source_revision: d3f3870d68c811adcc70a59fab3ec4040276b15d plus uncommitted feat/scoped-verification-evidence review fixes; exact evaluated plugin files retained in source.json before preparing any case.
model: Inherited Codex session model; exact runtime identifier was not exposed to the evaluators.
configuration: Twelve fork_turns=none evaluators, one fresh context per case. Each read only its TASK.txt, relevant frozen skill/references and raw repository snapshot. No rubric, prior conclusions, sibling cases, live plugin source, target check execution or remote retrieval was provided. Report self-validation was permitted. One submitted report (skipped-acceptance) needed a declared-state-only repair using frozen validator diagnostics; original retained. One semantic sample per case; sampling controls unavailable.
adjudicator: Parent agent reviewed all submitted reports against the independently authored withheld rubric. Portable report CLI separately checked structure and declared states. Retention verified prepared source and raw fixture bytes unchanged.
limitations: Twelve synthetic read-only scenarios and 36 manually reviewed criteria cover five skills but are not a reliability estimate or semantic certification. The adjudicator participated in integration. Eleven submitted reports passed portable validation without parent feedback; skipped-acceptance initially had two invalid ledger rows and was repaired after structure-only feedback. Its first artifact and hash remain retained; the repair changed only three state cells and preserved findings. All final reports pass structure validation. Exact plugin source and retained catalogs are preserved; the frozen implementation digest matches the live plugin files at completion.
